simulator.noCropsPlanted: You haven't planted any crops yet

perCrop.subtitle: Edit any number — the projection recalculates instantly.

simulator.disclaimer: ⚠️ Rough projections based on general averages — actual results vary with terrain, weather, and the market. Consult a licensed agronomist before making investment decisions.

home.createFarmError: Error creating the farm. Please try again.

export.title: Download backup
export.description: Download ALL of your account data as a JSON file: farms, fields, tasks, production, plant health, team, and custom crops.

import.title: Restore backup
import.description: Replace your account data with a previously exported backup. This substitutes everything current.

clear.title: Delete all data
clear.description: Deletes all your farms and records from your account. This cannot be undone.

toasts.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
toasts.invalidBackup: The file does not appear to be a valid Mi Finca PR backup.
toasts.newerVersion: This backup is from a newer version of the app.

restoreConfirm.title: Restore this backup?
restoreConfirm.message_one: The backup contains {{count}} farm. All current app data will be replaced.
restoreConfirm.message_other: The backup contains {{count}} farms. All current app data will be replaced.
restoreConfirm.message: ALL current account data will be replaced with the {{count}} farm(s) in the backup. Current records not in the file will be lost.

clearConfirm.title: Delete all data?
clearConfirm.message: All your farms, fields, tasks, production, and health records will be deleted from your account. This cannot be undone.

about.localData: Your data is stored locally in this browser. Download backups often.
about.disclaimer: Agronomic recommendations are guidance only and do not replace the advice of a licensed agronomist.

inApp.title: In-app notifications
inApp.description: Show operation alerts in the bell on the top bar.

emailDigest.title: Email reminders
emailDigest.description: We email you when a task enters your anticipation window, is due today, or becomes overdue. No news, no email.

overdue.title: Overdue operations
overdue.description: Alerts when an operation passed its recommended date without being completed.

dueSoon.title: Upcoming operations
dueSoon.description: Alerts about operations due within the lead-time days.

harvest.title: Harvest windows
harvest.description: Alerts when a crop's harvest window is approaching or opens.

leadDays.title: Lead-time days
leadDays.description: How many days before the recommended date the alert starts (1–60). Also sets when the email reminder arrives.

notifications.footer: Email and text message alerts will arrive in a future version.

emailFrequency.title: Email frequency
emailFrequency.description: Novedades: only when something crosses a line (at most one per day). Weekly: a Monday summary of everything pending.

notificationBell.title: Notifications
notificationBell.empty: All caught up — no pending operations coming up. 🌱

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.description: An unexpected error occurred in the app. Your saved data has not been lost. Reload the page to continue.

account.deleteDescription: Permanently deletes your account, your farms, and all their data. Members of your farms lose access; records you made on other farms remain without your name.
account.confirmWarning: This cannot be undone. Your farms, fields, corrals, animals, tasks, findings, and production will be deleted. Consider exporting your data (CSV) first.

demoBanner.text: Demo mode — exploring with sample data. This farm is deleted after a few days.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.body: This is a demo farm with sample data. Everything really works: tap around, check off tasks, and explore freely — nothing here is permanent.

map.title: Your farm map
map.body: The green boundary is your land over satellite imagery. Inside are your fields: Los Plátanos, Café de Altura, and El Gallinero.

drawer.title: Your fields
drawer.body: This tab opens the field list. Each field shows its plants and the tasks that are due, ready to check off with Complete · Partial · Skip. There is an overdue fertilization waiting for you!

boundary.title: Boundary and new fields
boundary.body: This button edits the farm boundary and creates new fields: draw the area on the map and fill it with rows of your crop.

panel.title: The dashboard
panel.body: What is happening today: overdue and upcoming tasks (crops AND animals), recommendations, and health alerts — all checkable from here.

cuaderno.title: The field notebook
cuaderno.body: Everything is recorded: plantings, tasks, production, and plant health. Exportable to CSV — the record agricultural certifications ask for.

finish.title: Explore!
finish.body: Check off the overdue fertilization, report a finding, log eggs from the coop… When you want your own farm, create your free account from the bar above.
